init.title: Aqara U200 options
init.description: **Real-time BLE state** holds one Bluetooth connection open so the lock's own push reports (open/close, and more) arrive instantly — the BLE-native way to see keypad/key/manual opens, no polling. **Background poll (hours)** reads battery + settings periodically: 0 = off (on-demand only, via the Refresh button). **Offline mode** fetches the lock's key once at startup and then runs the Bluetooth channel without a per-operation cloud call (the key is kept only in memory; it falls back to the cloud if the fetch fails). **Keypad wake switch** (optional) is a switch (e.g. a fingerbot on the keypad) the integration presses to wake the sleeping front panel for credential/setting operations. Every Bluetooth read costs a little lock battery and, on a shared proxy (e.g. ESPHome), a connection slot — keep the poll off or long if that matters.

pin.name: PIN
pin.description: The visitor PIN — an even number of decimal digits (e.g. 6 or 8).

delete_user.name: Delete credential
delete_user.description: Delete a credential (and its user) from the Aqara U200 over Bluetooth. The front keypad panel must be awake — the integration wakes it (or asks you) first and errors if it stays asleep.
